paper_title: A Model-Independent Radio Telescope Dark Matter Search in the L and S Bands
notes: This paper constrains the dark matter decay constant lambda (~10^-32 s^-1) and annihilation cross section <sigma v> (~10^-30 cm^3/s) for generic ultralight bosonic DM radiatively decaying/annihilating to radio lines (1020-2700 MHz). The reported limits are on decay rate and annihilation cross section, NOT on a standard coupling constant like g_agamma. The analysis assumes two-photon final states generically and is explicitly model-independent, not tied to the axion-photon coupling. None of the enum coupling types match the reported quantities (decay constant lambda in s^-1, cross section in cm^3/s). The 3-sigma p-value criterion is used; CL set to 0.90 as approximation. Local DM density ~0.471 GeV/cm^3 (NFW). No data points extractable in the requested coupling units; the y-axes are lambda [s^-1] and <sigma v> [cm^3/s], which are not convertible to a single coupling type without model assumptions. The pre-analysis hint of AxionPhoton is not appropriate here.
